issues.legal_issue: Interest payable for a delayed land acquisition is calculated on the land’s market value and does not include the additional amount awarded for compulsory acquisition.
material_facts: The acquisition declaration was made more than three years after publication of the initial acquisition notification, bringing the acquisition within the provision for interest due to delay.
The applicable provision stated that interest was payable on the land’s market value as determined under the acquisition law.
The court awarded an additional 15% of the market value for the compulsory nature of the acquisition, and the dispute was whether interest also applied to that amount.
issues.conclusion: Interest under the delay-related provision is payable on the market value only, not on the additional 15% awarded for compulsory acquisition. The appeal succeeded to the extent that the amount payable had to be computed on that basis.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 4(3) of the Land Acquisition (Amendment and Validation) Act, 1967, and 23(1) and 23(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, market value and compensation are distinct: compensation includes market value and the additional amount awarded for compulsory acquisition, but a provision specifying interest on market value does not extend interest to that additional amount. Sections 28 and 34 of the Principal Act use the broader term compensation, supporting the distinction. Raja Vyringharla Narayana Gajapatiraju v. Revenue Divisional Officer, Vizagapatam describes market value by reference to an arm’s-length willing vendor and purchaser. Chaturbhuj Panda v. Collector, Rajgarh, Sub-Collector of Godavari v. Saragam, and Krishna Bai v. Secretary of State for India in Council do not establish that the additional compulsory-acquisition amount is market value; Chaturbhuj Panda concerned the meaning of land and the value of trees. The contrary decision in Union of India v. Nathu was overruled.

rule.if: special_acquisition_delay_interest_case and delayed_acquisition_declaration and interest_base_is_market_value and compulsory_acquisition_addon_awarded

predicates.special_acquisition_delay_interest_case: The proceeding concerns a claim for interest arising from delay in completing a land acquisition.
predicates.delayed_acquisition_declaration: The acquisition declaration was made after the required period had elapsed following the initial acquisition notice.
predicates.interest_base_is_market_value: The governing interest requirement identifies the land’s market value as the base on which interest is payable.
predicates.compulsory_acquisition_addon_awarded: An additional amount was awarded because the land was acquired compulsorily.

issues.definition: When a delayed-acquisition interest proceeding has a late declaration, identifies market value as the interest base, and includes an award for compulsory acquisition, the interest excludes that additional award.
